initial_simplification: Mice are very important for studying the brain. Scientists use them to learn how the brain works. For a long time, researchers chose male mice for their experiments. They did this because they worried that female mice, which go through hormone changes, might behave differently and affect the results.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are very important in brain research because scientists can easily control and study them. Researchers often choose male mice for experiments instead of female mice. This is partly because female mice have hormone changes that can make their behavior different, which might affect the results.
